Headline: O'Hare-bound Blue Line Delays
ShortDescription: O'Hare-bound Blue trains are running with residual delays following an sick rider at Illinois Medical District.  Service is resuming, allow extra time.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
O'Hare-bound Blue trains are running with residual delays following an sick rider at Illinois Medical District. 

Trains are moving and normal service is being restored.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: #93 California/Dodge Temporary Reroute at Dempster/Asbury
ShortDescription: #93 California/Dodge buses are temporarily rerouted due to street blockage near Dempster/Asbury.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#93 California/Dodge buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via Dempster, Ridge, Lake, and Dodge, due to street blockage near Dempster/Asbury.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: #29 State Temporary Southbound Reroute near Grand/Rush

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
